cause_quote: The new inline validation span used `class="cfg-field__error settings-control__sr-label"`, which clipped the explanation to a 1×1 pixel box.
user_saw: An invalid scalar setting turned red without showing why the value was rejected.
summary: The fix removes the screen-reader-only class so Settings displays the validation reason beside the field on desktop and below it on narrow screens.
reasoning: The parent commit set custom validity and `aria-invalid`, and #156050 introduced the inline error span and clipped it from the start. The Solid migration carried over the same class.
